expectations.text: 成功下载并解析 Jenkins build log
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 2: 'Downloaded full console log from http://10.66.12.40/job/wdp-ue/job/Earth/job/aes6-ue-runtime-ci/3913/consoleText' resulting in a '1137-line build log'. The build_log.txt file exists in outputs with 1138 lines of content, confirming successful download and parsing.

Transcript Step 4 identifies the fatal error: 'fatal error C1083: Cannot open include file: TextureRenderTargetResource.h: No such file or directory' at line 1083. The diagnosis.md confirms this as the single fatal compilation error. Verified against build_log.txt line 1083 which shows the same error. There was only one compilation error in this build (1 of 4 compile actions failed with a fatal error that halted compilation), so extracting this single error constitutes extracting 'all' compilation errors. The diagnosis also notes the StructUtils deprecation warning, which is a warning rather than an error.

expectations.text: 给出了包含根因和修复建议的诊断报告
expectations.evidence: diagnosis.md contains a detailed 'Root Cause Analysis' section explaining that TextureRenderTargetResource.h was moved/renamed in UE 5.5 engine restructuring, and the AesWorld plugin still references the old UE 5.4-era path. The 'Recommended Fix' section provides specific code migration guidance: replace '#include "TextureRenderTargetResource.h"' with '#include "TextureResource.h"' or '#include "Engine/TextureRenderTarget2D.h"'. The diagnosis identifies the exact plugin (AesWorld), source file, line number, and commit.
